how_it_is_used: scripts/music_lib.py in the video pipeline reads this file, picks the first track for the post mood, cuts from `start` (or the mood override), loops with a 0.8 s crossfade if the post needs more than the track has left, normalises to -12 dBFS RMS, adds the count/bell/hook/guess cues, then muxes. Change a mood mapping here and the next post follows it - no code change.
